request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

agent.result_text:
The rollover now soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in start-date order, right after the `ROLLOVER` line. The three rollover tests pass, but `bin/e2e` is not fully green: scenario 3 fails for a reason unrelated to this change.

**What changed**
- `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/RollOver.java`: after the `ROLLOVER` audit line, it goes through the old year's periods by start date. Each one that isn't already closed or soft-closed is soft-closed with `PeriodCloser.softClose`, the same code the manual soft close uses. That writes a `PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED … total=…` line for each and fixes its figures. A period that was already closed (2026-11 in the test) is skipped. This all happens before the response is built, so the screen gets the updated periods.
- I updated the comments in `RollOver.java` and `rollover.POST.yml` to match. No front-end or schema changes were needed.

**Test results:** 3 passed, 1 failed.
- The main test and scenarios 1 and 2 pass, including the expected order of audit lines and every old period showing "soft".
- Scenario 3 fails at spec line 2052. It expects a crew member's share of `33.34` in the past-date ("as of") view but gets `50.00`. That scenario never runs a rollover. The cause is in existing code: merging Cam into Ben deletes Cam's crew membership outright (`People.java:383`). The past-date view has no record of it, so on 2026-03-28 it shows 2 crew members instead of 3.

I didn't fix that, because it's outside this change request. Fixing it would mean keeping a history of crew memberships when people are merged, so past-date views can still see them. Should I take that on so the whole suite passes?
